Finding.Text: Three of the four commits of this change carry their "Change: C-0006-kernel-managed-paths" line in a paragraph of its own, separated by a blank line from the "Co-Authored-By" line, so git does not read it as a trailer: git log --format=%(trailers:key=Change) prints nothing for f6800bb, f18f457 and 8d32623 and the id for bee8a1f, where the two lines form one block. L-01 names "the Change: <id> commit trailer" as the mechanism by which records, commits and measurements join without reconstruction, and the kernel reads no trailer itself, so nothing in close is affected; a measurement that reads trailers through git will miss these three commits and find them only by text search. The messages cannot be amended now that they are pushed; for the author, the trailer block is the last paragraph and the Change line belongs in it beside Co-Authored-By, as the start-run commit has it.
